name: How do I choose a reliable contractor for bay window repair?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose a reliable contractor for bay window repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor for bay window repair, look for experience with the specific type of window and repair needed. Verify they are licensed and insured in California. Check their references, read customer reviews, and ensure they provide a detailed, written estimate outlining the scope of work, materials, and cost. A reputable contractor will also communicate clearly and offer warranties on their work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a licensed, insured contractor with experience, good references, detailed estimates, and warranties on their work.
